newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Delhaize sees big rise in 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Delhaize sees big rise in 1996 results.

text.p: Leading Belgian retail group Delhaize "Le Lion" SA said it expected a "significant increase" in consolidated results for full year 1996 compared to 1995, unless there were unfavourable fluctutations in currency rates.

"However the growth rate could be not as strong as the one achieved at the end of the first half of 1996, taking into account the good results of the second half of 1995," it added in a statement. Delhaize said its first half 1996 group net profit rose 22 percent to 1.974 billion Belgian francs.
